Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the correctly gathered birth years (Lucio Fulci 1927; H. Bruce Humberstone 1901) and drew an incorrect conclusion. They wrongly equated being older at a film’s release (Fulci at 54 in 1981 vs. Humberstone at 37 in 1938) with being born earlier, leading to the inverted claim that Fulci was born earlier. This logical error contradicted the data, as 1901 is earlier than 1927, so Charlie Chan in Honolulu has the director born earlier.
